scope: Formal conditional algebra only;actual finite fields,Galois action,Hom groups and geometric descent remain written bridges.
statement: theorem odd_sign_descent {H : Type} [IntModule H] (f : H → H) (a : H) (hneg : ∀ x, f (-x) = -f x) (htorsion : ∀ x : H, (2 : Int) • x=0 → x=0) (hne : a ≠ 0) (choices : f a=a ∨ f a = -a) (n : Nat) (hfixed : iterate f (2*n+1) a=a) : f a=a
